legal.description: Single judge directed Rapido, Ola, Uber to stop bike taxi services within 6 weeks unless state framed guidelines under Section 93 MV Act
Extended deadline to June 15, 2025 for bike taxi operators
Bike taxi operations paused in Karnataka; Rapido notified customers of compliance with HC order
Set aside April 2025 single judge order; directed state to register two-wheelers as transport vehicles and grant contract carriage permits; ruled blanket ban violates Article 19(6)

legal.entity: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (Centre)
legal.description: Issued Motor Vehicles Aggregator Guidelines 2025 giving states legal footing to permit non-transport motorcycles for passenger journeys via aggregators
Granted Rapido 5-year cab aggregator licence valid until August 2031 under Karnataka On-Demand Transportation Technology Aggregators Rules, 2016

Founders (Rishikesh SR, Pavan Guntupalli, Aravind Sanka) booked at Sitabuldi police station for operating petrol-powered bike taxis without government permission; case under BNS, Motor Vehicles Act, I
Association urged Karnataka govt to halt enforcement against bike taxi riders, citing lack of compliance framework after HC ruling
Karnataka submitted in SC that bike taxis are not public transport vehicles; challenged HC ruling allowing bike taxis
Discontinued Electric Bike Taxi Scheme 2021; Rapido claimed order limited to electric vehicles only
